text: The course helps students study basic theory and elementary knowledge in medical field, gain basic clinical skills of some common diseases diagnosis processing, get the basic treatment ability to urgent, difficult and severe symptoms, and be qualified for careers in hospitals, the medical and health units, medical science research departments as well as other organizations related medicine. Main Courses: Physiology, Biochemistry, Pharmacology, Anatomy, Pathology, Preventive Medicine, Immunology, Diagnostics, Internal Medicine, Surgery, Obstetrics And Gynecology, Pediatrics, Chinese Medicine, Histology and Embryology, etc. Degree Awarded: Bachelor’s Degree in Medicine
